classification: PROPOSED CONTRACT — NOT A GRANT. This file states what each business persona NEEDS so an explicit Owner ruling can compare need against the measured grant. Reading, seeding or applying this file must never change an authority: it registers no capability, writes no role_capabilities row, assigns no Role, and declares no Work Eligibility or Operational Scope. It is evidence for a decision, not the decision.

overview.note: A disjunction: readable iff at least one non-overview surface is readable.

ownerVsAdministrator.conclusion: Owner is business authority; Administrator is security-policy administration. Measured, the two are not currently distinguished that way: admin holds 66 capabilities and owner 47, owner is missing 17 it should hold, no Employee maps to owner, and the persona fixture merges Administrator INTO Owner / Executive. Restoring the owner-superset-of-admin contract is the prior step to expressing the distinction; the distinction itself is then made by what is assigned to the EMPLOYEE, which is where governance is meant to live.
